title: filter_properties rebuilds HashSet on every call — O(N*M) instead of O(N+M)
description: email.rs:560: let prop_set: HashSet<&str> = properties.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect(); This is inside filter_properties which is called once per returned Email object (email.rs:56-62 and snippet.rs). For a request returning 1000 emails with 10 properties, this builds 1000 HashSets each of size 10 instead of building one HashSet once before the loop. Fix: build the HashSet before the .map() in handle_email_get (and any other callers), pass it as a parameter or compute it once before the collect loop.
